programme.title: Rio Ngumoha : The Big Interview
programme.desc: At just 16 years and 361 days old, Rio Ngumoha became Liverpool's youngest ever goalscorer, scoring a 100th minute winner on his Premier League debut at Newcastle. The records kept on falling in the 2025/26 season as the young winger went from wonderkid to first team regular. The East Londoner reflects on his meteoric rise and the importance of family support along the way.

programme.title: The Tigers Return : PL Stories
programme.desc: Hull City's return to the Premier League is the latest chapter in a story built on resilience, ambition and belief. We look back on the club's previous adventures in the top-flight, reliving the moments that shaped its identity before looking ahead to an exciting new era. Joining the Tigers at their pre-season training camp in Slovenia, we go behind the scenes to discover how the club is preparing for the challenges ahead, as they aim not just to survive in the Premier League, but to establish themselves there for years to come.

programme.title: Hull City V Brighton \u0026 Hove Albion / Liverpool V Manchester United : Premier League LIVE
programme.desc: Premier League Live will be pitch-side at Anfield as the two most successful clubs in English football meet again when Liverpool host Manchester United. That clash at Anfield follows high-flying Brighton's trip to Hull City.

programme.title: (Subbed) Nemanja Matic : PL Stories
programme.desc: We follow Nemanja Matic's journey from his upbringing in Serbia to Premier League success with Chelsea and his time at Manchester United. He reflects on the experiences that shaped him, the challenges of establishing himself at the highest level and the managers who influenced his career. Through his story, we explore what it took to become a key figure in midfield for club and country.

programme.title: The Evolution Of The Premier League Goalkeepper : The Art Of...
programme.desc: Peter and Kasper Schmeichel explore how the art of goalkeeping has evolved throughout the Premier League era. From the fundamentals of shot-stopping, positioning and commanding the penalty area to the modern demands of distribution and playing with the ball at your feet, the Schmeichels break down what it takes to be an elite goalkeeper. Featuring some of the Premier League's greatest number ones, the show examines how one of football's most specialised positions has been transformed.

programme.title: Gavan Infinity
programme.desc: Menceritakan Kisah Reiji Doki, Penyelidik Polisi Federal Galaksi, Yang Mengemban Gelar Space Sheriff Gavan. Ia Menyelidiki Emorgear Energi Kehidupan Yang Bereaksi Terhadap Emosi Negatif Guna Menghentikan Ancaman Kriminal Lintas Dimensi Yang Dapat Meruntuhkan.

programme.title: Yaiba - Samurai Legend
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Petualangan Kurogane Yaiba, Seorang Bocah Liar Yang Dibesarkan Di Hutan Rimba Oleh Ayahnya Untuk Menjadi Seorang Samurai Sejati. Kehidupan Liarnya Berubah Total Saat Ia Harus Pindah Ke Kota Jepang Modern, Di Mana Ia Berteman Dengan Sayaka Mine Dan Masuk Ke Sekolah Formal.

programme.title: Cai Yoo (Cerita Anak Indonesia Yoo Yoo Yoo)
programme.desc: Program Hiburan Yang Edukatif Yang Disajikan Bagi Penonton Anak-Anak, Dipandu Oleh Seorang Host Yang Akan Mendatangi Sekolah-Sekolah Untuk Mengajak Siswa Bermain Sambil Belajar Bersama. Program Ini Akan Menampilkan Praktik Sains Dari Kakak Ilmuwan, Pertunjukan Dongeng, Hingga Pertunjukan Bakat Siswa Seperti Menyanyi, Menari, Berolahraga, Dll. Pada Setiap Bagian Program Terdapat Pembelajaran Bagi Siswa Yang Dikemas Lebih Menyenangkan.

programme.title: Adit Sopo Jarwo
programme.desc: Animasi Indonesia, Berisikan Kisah Kehidupan Sehari-Hari Masyarakat Indonesia Yang Dipenuhi Dengan Pengetahuan, Kelucuan, Kisah Persahabatan, Serta Nilai Persatuan, Kesatuan, Dan Kebudayaan. Tokoh Dalam Cerita Ini Diantaranya Adit (Tokoh Utama, Seorang Anak Laki-Laki), Adelya (Adik Adit), Teman-Teman Adit Yakni Dennis, Mitha, Dan Devi. Mereka Harus Berhadapan Dengan Duo Orang Dewasa (Sopo \u0026 Jarwo) Yang Selalu Mencari Celah Untuk Mendapat Keuntungan Tanpa Usaha. Perbedaan Paham Atau Cara Pandang Merupakan Bumbu Utama Yang Memicu Perseteruan Dan Kelucuan. Beruntung Di Antara Mereka Ada H. Udin, Ketua Rw Bijaksana Yang Selalu Menjadi Penengah Dan Memberikan Petuah Bijak Yang Disampaikan Dengan Ringan Serta Lugas Sehingga Mampu Mengembalikan Suasana Gaduh Menjadi Teduh.

programme.title: Abrakadabra
programme.desc: Abrakadabra Merupakan Sebuah Reality Show Yang Menghadirkan Hiburan Street Magician, Dimana Para Pesulap Akan Memberikan Keajaiban Dengan Trik-Trik Rahasia Yang Memukau Setiap Mata Di Sekitar Area Publik Untuk Mendapatkan Reaksi Kagum, Tak Percaya Dan Kaget Dari Penonton Maupun Semua Orang Yang Melihatnya Secara Langsung Di Lokasi.

programme.title: Bread Barbershop
programme.desc: Bread, Seorang Tukang Cukur Jenius, Memecahkan Masalah Penampilan Dengan Keterampilan Memotong Rambutnya Yang Briliant. Sekarang Dia Hadir Untuk Memecahkan Masalah Para Bintang Di Bakery Town. Bertentangan Dengan Penampilan Mereka Yang Glamor Dan Bersinar, Para Selebriti Ini Menjalani Hari Yang Sangat Suram. Bread Dan Keluarganya Siap Membantu Para Selebriti Untuk Menemukan Lagi Kebahagiaan Mereka.

programme.title: Super Wings
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Perjuangan Jett Dan Timnya Dalam Melindungi Bumi Dan Luar Angkasa Dari Golden Boy, Yang Berhasil Mencuri Sumber Energi Kosmik Kuat Bernama Star Core. Dengan Kekuatan Star Core, Golden Boy Melompati Dimensi Ruang-Waktu Dan Mengancam Keseimbangan Alam Semesta. Untuk Menghentikannya, Tim Super Wings Harus Meluncurkan Markas Besar Ruang Angkasa Mereka, Menjelajahi Berbagai Dimensi Ekstrem, Hingga Terlibat Dalam Pertempuran Robot Raksasa Demi Merebut Kembali Energi Tersebut Dan Menyelamatkan Dunia.

Dibantu Oleh Jin Seorang Gadis Remaja Yang Selalu Bijaksana, Mereka Bekerja Sama Dan Membuat Kota Brooms Town Menjadi Kota Ternyaman Bagi Warganya.

programme.title: Ijin, Ndan !
programme.desc: Ijin, Ndan Adalah Program Crimetainment Yang Menggabungkan Informasi Seputar Kejahatan Dan Kriminalitas Dengan Sketsa Komedi Situasional Yang Berlatar Di Ruang Interogasi Atau Kantor Polisi. Dipandu Oleh Tiga Host Utama Yaitu Komandan Zack, Bro Dim, Dan Miss Binal, Setiap Episodenya Juga Menghadirkan Berbagai Cameo Menarik Seperti Tahanan, Petugas Kebersihan, Hingga Karakter Unik Lainnya Yang Menambah Keseruan. Dengan Gaya Penyajian Yang Ringan, Menghibur, Dan Penuh Humor, Ijin, Ndan Tetap Konsisten Menyampaikan Fakta Aktual Dan Pesan Edukatif Kepada Penonton, Menjadikannya Tontonan Yang Informatif Sekaligus Mengundang Tawa.

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: The third leg of the race sees the teams leave behind the jungles of Borneo to reach the island of Sulawesi, an Indonesian wonderland that lies far from the tourist trail.

programme.title: Bill's Included
programme.desc: When Bill's wife walks out on him for the gardener, he's left lonely and broke. In the hope of turning his life around, he lets out his spare rooms to four students.

programme.title: This Is BBC TWO
programme.desc: A preview of upcoming programmes from BBC Two.

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Hamza Yassin heads to a secret location in Scotland's Southern Uplands to join a dedicated team on an exciting mission to protect the fastest animal in the world - the peregrine falcon. Getting up close to three chicks, he discovers how DNA sampling is helping tackle the theft of these remarkable birds. Along the way, the programme revisits memorable Countryfile wildlife encounters, from dolphins off Anglesey to spectacular starling murmurations at Newport Wetlands.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A comprehensive compilation of the latest and the most important news stories, updates and developments from the UK and different parts of the world.

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: In a special episode from North Sutherland, Dougie steps out into the Flow Country. Arlene catches up with Joyce Campbell to see her switch from sheep to regenerative farming.

programme.title: Beechgrove Garden
programme.desc: Indonesian cook and gardener Dina Watt goes from garden fork to table fork. Dina grows to cook in her Banchory garden, creating tasty and innovative dishes with her homegrown produce and adding an Indonesian twist to her Scottish-grown crops.

programme.title: A Cook Abroad
programme.desc: Scottish chef Tony Singh travels to India, the country of his ancestors, to trace his family roots and discover whether his mum's Punjabi cooking is the real deal. He begins his journey in Amritsar before braving the Grand Trunk Road to Delhi.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: Eva charts the history of French cuisine via a seven-course fine dining meal aboard a Seine riverboat.

programme.title: The Man Who Never Was
programme.desc: Espionage story of a British intelligence officer who plans an elaborate hoax in the spring of 1943 to fool the Germans into thinking the Allies are about to invade Greece, not Sicily. The plan calls for the navy to float a dead body carrying false identification and information so that the Germans will pick it up. The first part of the mission succeeds, but will the Nazis take the bait?

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: In Scotland, Martel encounters a house with a safety order attached, meaning certain rooms cannot be accessed. Meanwhile, in south Wales, Owain views a sizeable unit with significant development potential.

programme.title: Live: WSL
programme.desc: Coverage of the Women's Super League clash between Arsenal and West Ham United.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin is joined by experts Michael Baggott and Claire Rawle at Longleat in Wiltshire. Claire makes a momentous discovery of Tibetan artefacts belonging to a collection of controversial historical significance, which all end up under the hammer.

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: In the fourth leg, the teams enter a new frontier, Australia. The sixth-largest country on the planet and home to eight distinct climate zones, it's a land of extreme contrasts.

programme.title: This Farming Life
programme.desc: Spring is in the air, bringing newborn livestock. In North Uist, Carianne spends her days on the tiny island of Vallay in search of new Highland calves. When one calf is discovered without a mother, Carianne must turn detective to reunite them.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: Founded by the ancient Celts, Brittany has a rugged, wild character and some fresh seafood.

programme.title: Ireland with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: Starting at the spectacular Giant's Causeway in Northern Ireland, Simon travels down the east coast to the great and rapidly changing cities of Belfast and Dublin. He ends his journey in the stunning Wicklow Mountains.

programme.title: Mortimer and Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Paul and Bob fish two vast loughs in County Tyrone, hoping to lure an elusive pike out of hiding. Bob has a fail-safe method to try, but will he manage to catch one?

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: With brothers Joel and Johnny along for the ride, Bill reflects on losing their father young, and how caddying and golf helped bind nine siblings together.

programme.title: Rewarding
programme.desc: Special measures put Sinead under pressure as the team training day sparks a bet between Fidelma, Cyril and Francis. Meanwhile, Nicola chaperones Joe to his Granda Lips' funeral.

programme.title: Sunday Politics Northern Ireland
programme.desc: Mark Carruthers looks at the political developments of the week and questions policymakers on the key issues.

programme.title: Uncanny
programme.desc: Lindsey and her family experience terrifying events in their new-build house on the Isle of Thanet in Kent. Could the answers lie beneath their feet?

programme.title: Live at the Apollo
programme.desc: Tim Renkow welcomes comedians Janine Harouni and Stuart Goldsmith to the stage.

programme.title: Suzie Lee's Great Food Made Simple
programme.desc: Suzie visits Tully Mill in Co Fermanagh and is inspired to make a chocolate brownie with a chocolate mousse and a cherry compote.

programme.title: Blue Velvet
programme.desc: When Jeffrey Beaumont discovers a severed ear in a field, his curiosity leads him into the world of extreme violence and weird sex controlled by Frank Booth, a criminal totally out of control, and Dorothy Vallens, a damsel in distress who seems to be in his thrall - or is she?

programme.title: Question Time
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce presents an hour of debate from Worthing. On the panel are David Lammy, Joe Robertson, Adrian Ramsay, Alex Depledge and Fraser Nelson.

programme.title: Honey
programme.desc: Martha is annoyed after Kurt steals their joint credit for locating Kamilla, and she vows to gain access to the scientist alone. A competitive Kurt promises to do the same. Friedrich is ordered by his boss Schimmel to ramp up his efforts to locate Greta, believing she is the key to the Hermann Metzl case. Eager for a win, Martha and Kurt attempt to insinuate their way into Friedrich's confidence to find Greta. Stung by his reaction, Martha steals a prized possession.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Colin Murray discovers a brown sauce revival and the advantages of getting fish from a fishmonger as he visits Derry/Londonderry's Walled City Market. Briony-May Williams explores how Somerset is rivalling France in cheese production, and Onkar Singh Purewal discovers the secrets of beekeeping. Chef Julie Lin is in Dundee finding out how bakers keep up with demand around the clock.

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael starts a new railway journey in Newcastle, heading north to Berwick-upon-Tweed. His route takes in the River Tyne, Hadrian's Wall, a former mining village and the fishing port of Amble.

programme.title: Trawlermen: Hunting the Catch
programme.desc: As Storm Arwen hits UK waters, Victory Rose decides when to take shelter from the storm. Crabber Siwrengale has three days to make a week's wages, and Revival goes in search of North Sea prawns.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team return to Coughton Court in Warwickshire, where the experts get excited about an Agatha Christie letter, a medal awarded to those who came to the aid of the Titanic survivors and a rare china figure of the Queen on horseback.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin is joined by experts Christina Trevanion and Will Axon in Oxford Union to pick out a selection of interesting antiques and collectables to be sold at auction.

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Catherine Bohart, Chesney Hawkes, Rebecca Keatley and Jason Mohammad take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games wheelie luggage, or will they be tempted by the House of Games skateboard?

programme.title: Strictly Come Dancing: It Takes Two

programme.title: Global Eye

programme.desc: Winnie Ama, And So I Watch You From Afar, and guests Hothouse Flowers perform.

programme.title: The Chaplet of St. Michael
programme.desc: Mother Angelica and the Nuns of Our Lady of the Angels Monastery pray the chaplet of St Michael to honour the greatest warrior of the heavens.

programme.title: How to Pray for Your Sons & Daughters & Loved Ones
programme.desc: When we pray for our loved ones, we pray in the company of Jesus.

programme.title: Web of Faith 2.0
programme.desc: Viewer questions are answered about why priests are called 'Father', when people are not allowed to receive Holy Communion, who can bless a home, and whether Mary was perfect.

programme.title: The Choices We Face
programme.desc: Important figures in the religious community join hosts Ralph Martin and Peter Herbeck for an enlightening discussion of topics surrounding faith and life in the Catholic Church.

programme.title: My Country, My Faith: Ireland
programme.desc: Kathy Sinott and Fr Brian McKevitt join host Fr Owen Gorman to talk openly about abuse scandals, poor catechesis and erosion of Catholic faith.

programme.title: Hidden Gems - Catholic Shrines in America
programme.desc: Uncover the rich history and spiritual legacy within the magnificent Basilica Shrine of Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal in Philadelphia, founded in 1927 by Fr. Joseph A Skelly.

programme.title: Becoming Catholic
programme.desc: Fr Krause talks about the teaching of Jesus Christ on the Kingdom of God, the beatitudes, and how the Incarnation was God's answer to suffering and death.

programme.title: Lamb's Supper
programme.desc: The Todah in the Old Testament are fulfilled in the Holy Eucharist.

programme.title: The Old Testament Prophets
programme.desc: Father Mitch Pacwa hosts the second part of his discussion on Moses, this time as a law-giver.

programme.title: Forgotten Heritage: Europe and Her Saints
programme.desc: The influence of St Benedict on European Christianity and culture as a whole.

programme.title: The Holy Land Rosary
programme.desc: Fr Mitch Pacwa leads the Glorious Mysteries of the Rosary from the actual holy sites and shrines where they took place, bringing the Gospels to life and offering a deeper understanding of the rosary meditations.

programme.title: The Litany of Saint Joseph
programme.desc: The Franciscan Missionaries of the Eternal Word recite the litany dedicated to Saint Joseph in order to worship and seek his blessings.

programme.title: The Word Was Made Flesh
programme.desc: Fr Apostoli tells the story of the Samaritan woman who encounters Jesus at Jacob's Well.

programme.title: Nanes' Holocaust Symphony No. 3
programme.desc: Pianist and composer Richard Nanes performs a symphony reflecting on the Holocaust. Martin Bookspan offers commentary.

programme.title: Life Is Worth Living
programme.desc: The late Archbishop Fulton J. Sheen discusses the timeless issues of Catholicism. Archbishop Sheen discusses human nature in general.

programme.title: Saints vs. Scoundrels
programme.desc: Benjamin Wiker, PhD presents the lives of some of the most influential and interesting figures from throughout history. Examine their lives, their impact and the difference it makes to accept God or reject Him.

programme.title: Called to Communion with Dr. David Anders
programme.desc: Catholic catechist, writer and speaker Dr David Anders answers questions from non-Catholics, atheists and former Catholics on topics including Christian religion, spirituality and ethics.

programme.title: Mother Angelica Live Classics
programme.desc: The entire family will enjoy Mother's world-famous witty wisdom. From the hilarious to the miraculous to the purely poignant, we have compiled your all-time favourites to inspire, educate, and entertain you all over again.

programme.title: Bob and Penny Lord Present
programme.desc: Bob and Penny Lord explore the life of the founder of the Congregation of the Oratory, St. Philip Neri.

programme.title: I Forgive, With Immaculée Ilibagiza
programme.desc: Mardy and Audrey Jones learn how to forgive themselves and each other to heal from the scourge of alcoholism and the wounds of domestic violence. Later, Fr Thomas Berg and Dr Timothy Lock provide insights.

programme.title: Angelus With Pope Leo XIV
